record.oneLiner: A hollow-crested hadrosaur known from nests and hatchlings.
record.description: Hypacrosaurus was a lambeosaurine 'duck-billed' hadrosaur of Late Cretaceous Alberta and Montana, similar to Corythosaurus but with a lower rounded crest. It is well known from nests, eggs and hatchlings — the latest good hollow-crested hadrosaur in North America.

notableFacts.text: Known from nests, eggs and hatchlings, illuminating hadrosaur growth.
Had a tall, hollow, rounded head crest.
